_comment: Suite node-ID counts as of the last compaction (ADR-082526-547c). This file is HALF the expected count; the other half is the sum of per-change deltas in docs/testing/inventory-notes/*.md front matter. expected = counts[suite] + sum(deltas). Storing an absolute here and nowhere else is the point: a shared absolute is what made every test-adding branch conflict with every other one (#208), because two PRs both rewrote it -- and adjacent table rows conflicted even across unrelated suites. Deltas live one-per-change so two PRs never write the same path. Do not hand-edit `counts`: it moves only when `check-suite-inventory.py --compact` folds deltas in, which also appends their slugs to `folded` so notes themselves are never rewritten. `folded` is how a note is known to be already counted; a note listed there is skipped.
